title: Frozen scope -> theme imputation map (x8)
note: VIEW ONLY. This table imputes each historical git commit to exactly one perennial theme for a computed coverage view. It is NEVER written into .track — the event log is not rewritten for history. Only track ITEMS were physically reparented (see 2026-07-06-wp-restructuring-REPARENT-PLAN.md). Consumers: docs/specs/wp-coverage-report.md.
algorithm: 1. Parse conventional type + scope from the subject.
2. type=release OR scope is a bare version (v?N.N.N) -> distribution-cli-packaging (releases -> distribution).
4. type=ci -> subject matches /publish/ ? distribution-cli-packaging : method-harness (CI -> method/infra).

5. scope begins with 'track' -> if the commit touches packages/track/** then tracking-record (tool dev), else fall through to scopePatterns on the subject (track used as a record verb in another theme).
6. scopePatterns matched against the FULL lowercased subject, FIRST match wins.
7. no match -> manual-review (imputed-but-to-review; listed by SHA in the coverage report).

trackScopeRule.rationale: Historically the track tool lived under src/ (monorepo), later packages/track/. A track-scoped commit editing track SOURCE = tool-dev = tracking-record. A track-scoped commit touching only .track/ (+docs) = record-keeping: impute to the recorded theme if the subject names one, else tracking-record (record activity).
